answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. What survives to the garden is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The delta holds work receipts rather than names, so the vault of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
